description: Sample and hold with an internal analogue noise source, an internal clock, and slew on its output

params.text: Switches the circuit between sample and hold, and hold and track, which is an inverted track and hold
Full wave rectifies the signal, folding negative voltage positive
Sets the level of the sampled signal, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Output Level
Slews the output, smoothing the step from one held voltage to the next
Sets the rate of the internal clock that samples the input while nothing is patched to CLK IN
Switches the internal clock between its fast and slow ranges

inputs.text: The signal that gets sampled; unpatched, the internal noise source is normalled here
A rising edge takes a sample, in place of the internal clock

outputs.text: The held voltage, after the level and slew controls
Analogue white noise, normalled to the sample input
